title: Cacao & Clay Ofrenda Circle (December)
source_quote: Cacao & Clay Ofrenda Circle | Sunday, 20 December | 18:00-20:30 | A unique opportunity to ground with the ancestral medicine of cacao while honoring the ancient practice of ceramics.
evidence_sentence: The event includes hands-on clay sculpting but no firing component.
evidence_quote: Each session includes seasonal reflection prompts, a cacao meditation rooted in Mayan Cosmovision, and hands-on clay sculpting using harvested nature treasures.
